description: Use for a rule-based risk label on an EVM address before paying it: exact OFAC SDN match, contract or plain account (Base, Ethereum), outgoing transaction count (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon), na. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /wallet/risk, $0.01 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
